item.title: Poor Free Throw Shooting Sinks Dalton State in Overtime Loss to UT Southern
item.description: Dalton, GA-(WDEF-TV) Dalton State struggled to knock down their free throws and wound up losing to UT Southern 91-85 in overtime on Thursday night at Bandy Gym. The Roadrunners were just 5-21 in the second half from the charity stripe. Qualen Pettus and Varan Danak each had 18 points to lead Dalton State. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
